prayerExcerpt.en-US: The sparrow finds a home, and the swallow a nest for her young: by your altars, O Lord of hosts, my King and my God.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O pássaro encontra abrigo e a andorinha um ninho para pôr os seus filhotes: os vossos altares, Senhor do universo, meu rei e meu Deus!

meta.basis: The altar is 'the table of the Lord' (GIRM 296). It is built free-standing (GIRM 299). The table of a fixed altar is traditionally of natural stone (GIRM 301; wood is allowed in the US), and it carries 'at least one cloth, white in color' (GIRM 304). Flowers go 'around the altar rather than on the altar table' (GIRM 305). Only what the Mass needs is placed on the altar (GIRM 306), so outside Mass it is bare but for its cloth. The crucifix and candles are left to their own card, 'Altar crucifix and candles'.
